Facts:
- The Saturn AL-31 is a family of military turbofan engines.
- The Saturn AL-31 currently powers all Sukhoi Su-27 derivatives and the Chengdu J-10 multirole jet fighter developed by China.
- The Chengdu J-10, NATO reporting name Firebird, is a lightweight all-weather multirole fighter aircraft with a delta wing, canard design, and fly-by-wire flight controls.
- Chengdu Aircraft Corporation produces the Chengdu J-10 for the People's Liberation Army Air Force in China.
- All members of the Sukhoi S-54 family resemble the Sukhoi Su-27 or more closely the Sukhoi Su-33, but they are scaled down around a single Saturn AL-31 engine instead of two.
- Kingway Brewery Holdings Limited is a leading beer maker in China.
